outcome: contribution of Robson classification groups to cesarean section rates
cohort: The participants were pregnant adults and adolescents for whom information on birth weight, mode of delivery, gestational age at birth, parity, maternal gestational age, cesarean indications, and ten-group Robson Classification was documented.
finding: The contribution of adult pregnant women and adolescent pregnant women to cesarean section rates varies across different Robson classification groups.
mod_finding: Robson classification Group 5 made the biggest contribution to cesarean section rates in both adult and adolescent groups, with significant differences observed across other specific groups (Group 3, 8 for adults; Group 1, 2, 6 for adolescents).
